When photon of energy 4.0 eV strikes the
surface of a metal A, the ejected photoelectrons
have maximum kinetic energy T<sub>A</sub> eV end
de-Broglie wavelength <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.345ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="2.707ex" height="1.916ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -694 1196.3 846.7" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D706" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D706"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(616,-152.7) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="1D434" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D434"></use></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>. The maximum
kinetic energy of photoelectrons liberated from
